title: *HIV/AIDS AND STIS IN MODERN SOCIETY
description: Fundamental principles relating to etiology, nature, prevention, and control of AIDS and other sexually transmitted diseases in contemporary society; emphasis on social, psychological, legal, economic, and ethical issues surrounding these diseases.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:20pm in LINC 303 - Learning Innovation Center 303 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
